# Build Product

Execute the reusable SDLC pipeline described in [the workspace prompt](../../prompts/build-product.prompt.md).

Treat the user's message as the product idea and follow the prompt's phases, artifacts, agent routing, approval policy, and completion report requirements. This skill exists so the workflow is available in Agent mode as well as Chat prompt-file mode.
